name: A Long Dance With Me, Yourself, and I
description:
Truth becomes fiction when fiction turns real. Standard disappearing acts are Aha's ideal
※ "Aha" is nothing more than a label, a simple alias. You could be called Aha, I could be called Aha, and so could they. Once you strip that alias away, who is Aha then? The answer awaits... in our next magic trick.
hiddenDescription: Truth becomes fiction when fiction turns real. Standard disappearing acts are Aha's ideal.
